query:
SELECT 
  po.id,
  po.docNumber,
  po.supplierId,
  s.name as supplierName,
  po.totalAmount,
  po.status,
  po.issueDate,
  po.docType
FROM purchaseOrders po
LEFT JOIN partners s ON po.supplierId = s.id
WHERE po.docNumber = '293138';
